description: This file defines the BillingClient class in the Aws\Billing namespace, which extends the AwsClient class. It provides method signatures and documentation for interacting with the AWS Billing service, including creating, deleting, fetching, and updating billing views, as well as managing resource policies and tags.

classes.name: BillingClient
classes.description: A client class to interact with the AWS Billing service, providing methods for managing billing views, resource policies, and tags.
